title: Watch out CX industry - Omnichannel personalization, data, and AI are here
excerpt: Mike Gadsby, our chief innovation officer, explores five trends in CX and marketing strategy innovation that are leading the revolution in customer expectations.

featuredImage.alt: Mike Gadsby, co-founder and Chief Innovation Officer.

children.text: The future of customer engagement is heading toward hyper-personalized CX journeys across all channels. It is imperative that companies develop the infrastructure to stay current with these new technologies as they evolve.
Mike Gadsby, our chief innovation officer, explores five trends in CX and marketing strategy innovation that are leading the revolution in customer expectations.
